source.description: Restrict to this owner/repo, plugin@marketplace, or manual.

root.description: Restrict to the global shared library folder.

skills.description: Restrict to these skill names; empty means all.

copy_status.description: Keep only the agent copies with this copy status.

SkillName.description:
Lexical skill name: the directory name that holds `SKILL.md`.

Invariant: two deployments with the same `SkillName` are the same skill,
even when their bytes differ. A symlink alias with another name is another
skill.

CopyStatus.description: How an agent copy compares with the library copy in its scope.

oneOf.description: A link that resolves to the library copy.
A real folder with the same files as the library copy.

A real folder with other files, changed after the last install or
update of the skill, or with no lock entry to compare with.

A real folder with other files, all older than the last install or
update in the lock file: the copy did not get that update.
